cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let work ring. I'd like to finish choosing our wedding vows with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm about to promise you my whole life. Could I have ten minutes before the client?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to cover. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her we're making promises too. Put ours in your calendar beside the client's.

mechanism: A ranks the couple promises above the client demand and grants only a delay plan that visibly reserves time for their relationship.
confusable: D73 seeks presence generally; D82 requires prioritizing this connection over a specific competing commitment.
comparison: Wedding vows competing with a client differs from home dinner competing with promotion networking.
seedUse: Use D82-a vow/client promise contrast; clarify whether Maya delays the meeting rather than replacing a supposedly indispensable signer.
